test_title: PYST 56: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

The employees were comfortable / with me and they talked about / their problems since / I has worked there as a manager.

options.text: I has worked there as a manager.
with me and they talked about

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb "**has**" instead of "**have**."
 
• The subject "**I**" requires the verb "**have**" to be grammatically correct.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I have worked there as a manager**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The employees were comfortable with me and they talked about their problems since I have worked there as a manager."*
